Frontend Engineer (Mid-level)

Quietly is hiring a frontend engineer to work on our scheduling dashboard.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain features in our React dashboard
- Work with designers to turn mockups into accessible components
- Improve page load performance

Requirements
- 3+ years building production web apps with React
- Solid understanding of HTML, CSS and accessibility (WCAG)
- Experience writing tests with Jest or Testing Library
- Comfortable giving and receiving code review feedback

Nice to have
- Experience with Next.js
- Some exposure to design systems
